b1.gazi_comes_to_liscor.news: Gazi of Reim, the King of Destruction's vassal, walked into Liscor beside the Human innkeeper and a cart of burned Shield Spiders.

canon_ref.note: Late the same day as the nest (Erin says Gazi helped her 'earlier today' in 1.38). The meeting at the pit is 1.36. Delta is a design value.

b1.gazi_comes_to_liscor.summary: At the burning pit, a half-Gazer adventurer finds Erin, talks with her about killing, and lends her coin for a wagon. In Liscor's Adventurers' Guild Erin signs for over sixteen Shield Spiders. Then her companion gives her name, Gazi of Reim, and the whole hall freezes in fear.

b1.relc_thrashes_adventurers.news: Senior Guardsman Relc beat six Human adventurers in the street outside the Adventurers' Guild with his bare hands.

canon_ref.note: Gazi reads him as over Level 30 in [Spearmaster]; Selys says Klbkch was ten levels lower.

b1.relc_thrashes_adventurers.summary: The crowd around Gazi spills into the street. Adventurers shove a guardsman, and Relc takes on six at once without his spear, tossing a man in plate into a wall. Selys tells Erin he may be the strongest city guard in the world. Gazi says she is done with war.

canon_ref.note: Same day as Gazi's arrival: the Queen hears of her. What the Queen is making is not said.

b1.free_queen_sends_ksmvr.summary: Deep in the Hive, the Queen hears of Humans and Gazi in Liscor. She is absorbed in a secret, hurried work and must not be disturbed. She names Ksmvr her Prognugator, tells him to handle the Council, watch Gazi and judge the Aberration who calls himself an individual.

system.name: [Spearmaster]
system.note: Over Level 30, as Gazi sees it.

system.name: Rumored over Level 40
system.note: Selys's word; Named-rank, among the world's top hundred adventurers.
